messages.subject: unmarked 0.9-9
parts:
Hi everyone,

There is a new version of unmarked on CRAN. Details are here: https://sites.google.com/site/unmarkedinfo/home/release-notes. One noteworthy change is that Dave Miller contributed a new function, occuFP, which fits occupancy models allowing for false positives. 

Cheers,
Richard
